'''Reena''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector's]] [[Reena system/Legends|Reena system]]. It was the capital of [[Reena Province]] and throneworld of [[House Reena/Legends|House Reena]]. It had a local day of 25 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] and a [[local year]] of 360 [[Local day/Legends|local days]]. It had [[Temperature/Legends|warm]], shallow [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and small continents, largely urbanized. It was the location of [[Reena University/Legends|Reena University]]. Three [[HX.6 Turbolaser Battery|HX.6 Turbolaser Batteries]] on its single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] protected the planet.
